title: 2NE1 "THE LISTENING" GUEST REVIEW
description:
[2NE1 "THE LISTENING" GUEST REVIEW]

2NE1 NEW ALBUM 'CRUSH' released online on Feb. 27th
Download on iTunes @ http://smarturl.it/2NE1_CRUSH

2NE1 held a private music-listening event, "THE LISTENING", with 21 guests including fans selected through on-line music-streaming sites and from 2NE1 fan club, as well as experts from different fields. This is their review of 2NE1's new album "CRUSH".
